title: Only six beds for trans victims of domestic abuse in UK, report finds
summary_full: Exclusive: Services say supreme court ruling on single-sex spaces has made it ‘almost impossible’ to find refuges for trans peopleThere are only six beds specifically for trans victims of domestic abuse in the UK, a report has found, with services saying it is “almost impossible” to find refuges for trans people since the supreme court ruling on single-sex spaces.Galop, an LGBTQ+ anti-abuse charity, called on the government to create an emergency national fund for specialist trans refuges, as many people were being turned away from mainstream services.
